title: In the Garden
lyrics: [G]I come to the garden alone,
While the [C]dew is still on the [G]roses;
And the [D]voice I hear, falling [G]on [D]my [G]ear,
The [A7]Son of God dis-[D]clos-[D7]es.
And He [G]walks with me, And He [D7]talks with me,
And He [C]tells me [D7]I am His [G]own;
And the joy we [B7]share as we [Em]tar-[D7]ry [C]there,
None [G]other has [D7]ever [G]known.
I [G]come to the garden alone, [G7]
While the [C]dew is still on the [G]roses;
And the [D]voice I hear, falling [G]on my [Em]ear,
The [A]Son of God dis[D]clos[D7]es.
And He [G]walks with me, and He [D]talks with me
And He [D7]tells me I am His [G]own;
And the [G]joy we [B7]share as we [Em]tarry [A7]there,
None [G]other has [D]ever [G]known.
He speaks, and the sound of His voice
Is so sweet the birds hush their singing,
And the melody that He gave to me
Within my heart is ringing.
I'd stay in the garden with Him
Though the night around me be falling,
But He bids me go; through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.
